title: MediFund Financial Support for Different Members of a Household
what_it_is: MediFund Financial Support for Different Members of a Household

sections.label: MediFund eligibility for family members
sections.summary: There are no stipulations that a patient cannot qualify for MediFund if any family member is already receiving MediFund support.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health whether there are any stipulations that a household already receiving financial support from MediFund for one family member is no longer eligible for such support for other family members.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There are no stipulations that a patient cannot qualify for MediFund if any family member is already receiving MediFund support.

sections.label: MediFund committee discretion and guidelines
sections.summary: MOH provides operational guidelines to MediFund committees and institutions, but committees have full discretion and assess families' means holistically on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In respect of that, the Ministry of Health (MOH) provides operational guidelines to the MediFund committees and the MediFund-approved institutions to facilitate their management of MediFund, so that there is some sort of consistency in the decision-making.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But actually, the MediFund committees have full discretion over the assessment of the applications.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In such situations, what they will do is assess the families' means and ability to pay for the patient's medical bills holistically.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: They will take into account the different income as well as other Government grants and support provided to the family.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, it is a holistic approach and I believe that is something that will be done on a case-by-case basis.
